name: Web
purpose: Websites whose main job is to publish content: landing pages, marketing and corporate sites, documentation and content sites. Adds content architecture, search and sharing, and the accessibility and performance checks public pages need.
use_when: The main thing people do is read, browse or find content, then leave or convert (contact, sign up, buy elsewhere).
Most pages are the same for every visitor, or vary only by language or simple personalisation.
Being found through search engines and shared links matters.
not_when: People sign in to create, change or manage their own data. Use Application for that part.
The site only exists as the front door of an app, with a page or two of marketing. Record those pages in DESIGN.md instead.
A framework or CMS is in use. Technology alone never activates a profile.

documents.when: The site connects to a CMS, form handler, search service or other systems worth describing beyond SYSTEM_DESIGN.md.

checks.name: Accessibility
checks.what: Automated accessibility checks on every page type, against the standard named in DESIGN.md §6.7.

checks.name: Performance budget
checks.what: Page weight and loading-speed budgets, measured on the key page types against the targets in SPEC.md.

checks.name: Links and metadata
checks.what: No broken links, and every page has the title, description and sharing metadata SEO.md requires.
